# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss Agnes Thorne  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young woman with light curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses stylishly and wears gowns featuring remarkably puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and refined young woman with a gentle spoken tone. She has a talent for drawing out her students' finest intellectual and moral qualities while capturing their affection. She encourages independent reflection and investigation in her pupils, departing from traditional rigid teaching methods.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne became the first female teacher employed in Brierley. She introduced interactive learning routines, including Friday recitations, nature 'field' days, and daily physical culture exercises. In November, she led the school in organizing a Christmas Night concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Though she received an offer to teach at a grade school in her home district, she chose to stay in Brierley to guide her students through their Regent's entrance examinations. She organized an after-school preparation class for her proficient pupils, including Nell Harcourt, Odette Pullen, Opal Pettigrew, Wilfred Mott, Elias Purdy, and Flossie Tulk. At the end of two years, her term in Brierley concluded, but all her Entrance class candidates successfully passed their examinations. In later years, she maintained a close relationship with Nell Harcourt and visited Grey Shutters as a guest.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P21](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0021)_
